description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

2-layer no-LayerNorm model. L1: shift heads copy previous 4 chars; MLP flags 'closer' tokens (non-digit after digit) with year/month/day roles by delimiter type/position, plus month-name trigram lookup. L2: one head per field attends to its role flag; MLP routes digits by output position.
Same circuit as ClosersRoles2L (closer role flags + per-field heads) with attention sharpness 12 and d_ff=84.
compact288 circuit with attention sharpness lowered to 5 (tests how sharp the hard-attention heads must be).
compact288 circuit with attention sharpness lowered to 2 (expected to blur the hard-attention heads and break).
Same circuit, compacted residual: d_model=288, 6 heads; C3/C4 stored as digit one-hots, month-name lookup written straight into MT/MU, digit-only OUT.
compact288 circuit, attention sharpness 8.
compact288 circuit, attention sharpness 3.5 (locating the sharpness threshold between 2 and 5).

compact288 with the YYYY.MM.DD format flag (head 4) disabled: end-of-text is always the year, so that format fails.
Drops the absolute-position format head: the YYYY.MM.DD format is detected at the end closer from a '.' flag on the char 3 back (C3). 5 heads, d_model=290, A=12.
